Jordan (Marketing): Hey design — launching the 'Pulse' benchmark next week. Need a GIF hero + a static PNG for blog + a smaller GIF for LinkedIn. Can you help with sizes and accessibility? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/launch-pulse :wave:
Maya (Design): Yep. Can you confirm dimensions and where each will live? blog hero (top of post), social (LinkedIn native), and email header? Also want to know max file size for email clients.
Jordan (Marketing): Blog hero: responsive (desktop ~1200px wide, mobile 600px). LinkedIn: 1200x627 (native recommended). Email header: 600x200 max. File size targets: GIF < 1MB for blog/social if possible, email GIF < 200KB ideally.
Eli (DesignOps): For GIFs under 1MB we'll likely need to do frame reduction + 8-bit palette. Recommend 800x420 for blog GIF export (scaled up via srcset). For blog PNG hero use 1600x640 2x retina export and let CDN handle resizing.
Maya (Design): Plan: make master animation at 1200x528, export three variants: 
```
- blog-large: 1200x528, loop 3x, convert to 8-bit GIF, optimize (gifsicle -O3)
- linkedin: 1200x627, shorter loop (1-2s), export GIF optimized
- email: 600x200, still fallback PNG if client blocks GIFs
```
Maya (Design): Also will deliver static PNGs at 1x and 2x for retina.
QA (Accessibility): Heads-up: GIF-only content should have an accessible alternative (static image + descriptive alt). If animation contains text, include a plain-text caption under the hero in the blog and a transcript in the post metadata. Also avoid flashing >3 times/sec.
Jordan (Marketing): Good call. We'll add a 1-line caption under the hero and alt copy. Can you add suggested alt and caption copy?
Maya (Design): Sure. Draft alt: "Benchmark results showing Redwood Inference latency vs cost - animated sparkline". Caption: "Benchmark pulse: faster inference, lower per-token cost — see detailed results below." Will add a longer transcript in the figma notes.
Eli (DesignOps): For export pipeline I can add an automated optimization step. Suggest commands we use: 
```
# resize + optimize
convert master.png -resize 1200x528 \
  -colors 256 -strip temp.png
gifsicle --optimize=3 --lossy=80 temp.png > blog.gif
```
Eli (DesignOps): I'll also add a step to generate a fallback static frame `blog-fallback.png` for email clients.
DesignBot: Export job queued for file "Pulse_Master_Animation". Estimated output sizes: blog.gif ~680KB, linkedin.gif ~420KB, email.gif ~180KB.
Sam (PM): Timeline check — can we get final assets by Wednesday EOD? Marketing needs to stage blog and pre-schedule LI post.
Maya (Design): Yes — I'll push drafts to Figma by Tuesday morning and final exports Wednesday afternoon.
QA (Accessibility): I'll review alt/caption and do a quick accessibility scan once drafts are up.
Jordan (Marketing): Thanks all. When you upload exports, please drop them in the campaign folder and ping me. :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): Will do — tagging @Jordan when exports are uploaded.
Eli (DesignOps): I'll add the export artifacts to S3 under s3://redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/ and post links here when ready.
DesignBot: Export job complete: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/blog.gif (680KB), https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/linkedin.gif (420KB), https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/email.gif (180KB)
Jordan (Marketing): Got them — looks good at first glance. Will coordinate with content for captions and scheduling.
Sam (PM): Nice work team. Closing dependency for launch creative.
Maya (Design): Thanks! Leaving notes in Figma about color/brand compliance and where to find the alt text.
QA (Accessibility): Quick note — blog GIF description slightly ambiguous. I'll send a suggested revision in DMs.
Jordan (Marketing): Appreciate it.
